titleEn: Mudroom Renovation Cost Vancouver & Metro Vancouver 2026 — From $3,000 to $35,000
titleZh: 溫哥華入戶玄關裝修費用 2026｜$3,000 到 $35,000 改造價格完整指南
contentEn:
Mudroom renovation cost in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver in 2026 ranges from $3,000 to $35,000, with most homeowners spending $5,000–$15,000 for a well-organized entryway that handles daily traffic, wet boots, and school bags. The final price depends on size, material grade, whether you need plumbing or electrical work, and whether you are removing walls or changing the layout.

What Is a Mudroom and Why Vancouver Homes Need One

A mudroom is the transitional space between the outdoors and the interior — the place where boots come off, coats hang up, and bags get dropped on the way in the door. In Vancouver's rainy climate, a functional mudroom prevents wet floors from spreading through the entire house, protects hardwood and carpet from salt and moisture damage, and reduces daily cleaning time. Many newer Vancouver homes include a mudroom by default, but character homes, older Vancouver specials, and many condos and townhouses have only a small entry closet — which is why so many Metro Vancouver homeowners add or renovate one during a renovation.

2026 Mudroom Renovation Cost Breakdown in Vancouver

The table below shows typical cost ranges for mudroom renovations in Vancouver, based on project scope and material quality.

Renovation LevelCost RangeWhat Is IncludedTimeline
Basic / Cosmetic$3,000 – $6,000Paint, new flooring, basic closet system, hooks and bench1–2 weeks
Mid-Range (Most Common)$6,000 – $15,000Semi-custom built-ins, porcelain tile, bench with storage, lockers, upgraded lighting3–5 weeks
High-End / Custom$15,000 – $35,000+Custom millwork, heated floors, laundry integration, dog wash station, specialty tile6–12 weeks

What Drives the Cost of a Vancouver Mudroom Renovation

Several specific factors determine where your project falls within that price range.

Size and Layout

A small entry closet conversion — turning an existing 6-foot-by-4-foot closet into a functional mudroom — typically costs $5,000–$8,000. A dedicated 50–80 square foot mudroom room renovation runs $12,000–$25,000. Larger mudrooms that are part of a whole-home main-floor renovation fall into the higher range.

Flooring Materials

Vancouver's wet climate makes flooring one of the most important decisions in a mudroom. Porcelain tile is the most durable choice — expect to pay $8–$20 per square foot for materials and installation. Luxury vinyl plank runs $5–$12 per square foot and handles moisture well. Sealed concrete is popular in modern renovations at $4–$8 per square foot. Hardwood is not recommended for high-traffic Vancouver mudrooms without a waterproof finish.

Built-In Storage Systems

Semi-custom closet systems from companies such as tidyded, Modified, or California Closets in the Vancouver area cost $1,500–$4,000 for a complete mudroom wall with bench, lockers, and shelving. Custom millwork from a Vancouver cabinet maker runs $3,000–$10,000 or more depending on the design.

Plumbing — Adding a Utility Sink or Laundry Connection

Many Vancouver mudrooms incorporate a small laundry area or a utility sink for rinsing muddy boots and paws. Adding plumbing for a new utility sink costs $1,500–$4,000 in Metro Vancouver, including permit fees. This is one of the most impactful upgrades for families with children or dogs.

Electrical Upgrades

Running new circuits for additional outlets, LED strip lighting inside lockers, or a heated floor system costs $800–$2,500. Heated floor systems — electric radiant mats under tile — add $800–$2,000 to the material budget but dramatically improve the Vancouver winter experience.

Structural Changes

Removing a wall to expand an entry closet into a mudroom, or reframing a doorway, requires a structural engineer or architect and a building permit in Vancouver. Budget $3,000–$8,000 for structural changes plus permit costs.

Do You Need a Permit for a Mudroom Renovation in Vancouver?

Simple cosmetic mudroom renovations — painting, flooring replacement, installing a closet system — do not require a building permit in Vancouver or most BC municipalities. You do need a permit if your mudroom renovation includes:

  • Moving or adding electrical circuits (electrical permit required)
  • Adding or relocating plumbing (plumbing permit required)
  • Removing or modifying a load-bearing wall (structural permit required)
  • Changing the occupancy or room function on your property title

Renovating a mudroom as part of a larger renovation project that already has a building permit is typically covered under that existing permit. Check with your municipality — Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, and Coquitlam each have slightly different thresholds for when a permit is required.

How Long Does a Mudroom Renovation Take in Vancouver?

A basic mudroom cosmetic renovation takes 1–2 weeks from demo to final cleanup. A mid-range mudroom with custom built-ins takes 3–5 weeks. A high-end mudroom with plumbing, electrical, and structural changes takes 6–12 weeks, especially if you are working with a Vancouver renovation contractor who is also managing other trades.

Is a Mudroom Renovation Worth It in Vancouver?

For Vancouver homes without a dedicated entry space, a mudroom renovation consistently ranks among the highest-ROI renovations in homeowner surveys. A well-designed mudroom with durable flooring, a bench with storage, and a designated place for each family member's items reduces daily clutter throughout the entire home. In Vancouver's real estate market, a renovated, functional entryway also adds perceivable value when you sell.

FAQs: Mudroom Renovation Cost in Vancouver 2026

What is the average cost of a mudroom renovation in Vancouver?

The average mudroom renovation cost in Vancouver is $8,000–$12,000 for a mid-range mudroom with semi-custom built-ins, porcelain tile flooring, and a bench with storage. Basic cosmetic mudroom renovations start around $3,000–$6,000.

Do mudrooms add value to Vancouver homes?

Yes. A well-designed mudroom adds functional living space, improves daily livability, and appeals to buyers in Vancouver's competitive real estate market. The return on investment is particularly strong in family neighbourhoods such as East Vancouver, Burnaby, Coquitlam, and Richmond.

Can I add a mudroom to a small Vancouver condo or townhouse?

Yes. Many Vancouver condos and townhouses benefit from a mudroom renovation that converts an existing entry closet or unused corner into a functional drop zone. A closet conversion mudroom in a strata property may require strata approval before construction begins.

What flooring is best for a Vancouver mudroom?

Porcelain tile is the best flooring for a Vancouver mudroom because it is completely waterproof, durable enough for heavy foot traffic and muddy boots, and available in styles that complement any interior design. Luxury vinyl plank is a practical alternative at a lower cost. Sealed concrete works well in modern and industrial-style Vancouver homes.

Does a mudroom renovation require a building permit in Vancouver?

Cosmetic mudroom renovations — flooring, painting, installing a closet system — do not require a building permit. Permits are required when electrical circuits are added or moved, when plumbing is installed or relocated, or when structural walls are modified. contentZh:
溫哥華及大溫哥華地區的入戶玄關（泥屋）裝修費用在2026年約為 $3,000 至 $35,000 加幣，大多數業主的實際支出在 $5,000 至 $15,000 之間。這個價格範圍涵蓋從基本的入口走廊改造到配備齊全、功能完善的入戶泥屋。

什麼是泥屋（Mudroom）？為什麼溫哥華家庭需要它

泥屋是連接戶外與室內的過渡空間——在這裡脫下沾泥的鞋子、掛外套、把書包隨手放下。溫哥華雨水頻繁，沒有泥屋的家庭常常看到濕漉漉的地板延伸到整個房屋，造成實木地板和地毯受潮損壞。許多新建房屋已標配泥屋，但對於老房子、公寓和聯排別墅，很多業主在裝修時選擇自己加建或改造入戶空間。

2026年溫哥華泥屋裝修費用明細

裝修級別費用範圍包含內容工期
基礎/輕裝修$3,000 – $6,000刷新油漆、更換地板、基本收納系統、掛鉤和換鞋凳1–2週
中等（最常見）$6,000 – $15,000半定制嵌入式收納、瓷磚地板、帶儲物的長凳、 locker 儲物櫃、升級照明3–5週
高端/全定制$15,000 – $35,000+定制細木加工、地面供暖、洗衣設備整合、寵物沖洗區、特種瓷磚6–12週

影響泥屋裝修費用的主要因素

面積與格局

將現有的衣櫃空間（約6×4英尺）改造成功能性泥屋，費用約 $5,000–$8,000。獨立泥屋（50–80平方英尺）的裝修費用為 $12,000–$25,000。

地板材料

考慮溫哥華潮濕氣候，瓷磚是最耐用的選擇，材料和人工費用約 $8–$20/平方英尺。豪華乙烯基塑料地板（LVP）約 $5–$12/平方英尺，防潮效果好。密封混凝土適合現代風格房屋，約 $4–$8/平方英尺。不建議在泥屋使用未做防水處理的實木地板。

嵌入式收納系統

溫哥華本地定製品牌的半定制泥屋收納牆（含長凳、儲物櫃、架子）費用約 $1,500–$4,000。從溫哥華細木工匠定制的全屋木作費用 $3,000–$10,000 以上。

水管工程

在泥屋增設Utility sink（多功能清洗池）或洗衣設備連接，費用約 $1,500–$4,000（含許可證）。對於有孩子或寵物的家庭，這是回報率最高的升級之一。

電力改造

新增電路、LED嵌入式照明或地暖系統，費用約 $800–$2,500。電地暖系統在瓷磚地板下額外增加 $800–$2,000，但在溫哥華漫長的冬季非常實用。

結構改造

拆除牆壁擴大入口空間需要結構工程師評估和建築許可，費用 $3,000–$8,000額外預算。

泥屋裝修需要申請許可證嗎？

純裝飾性泥屋裝修（油漆、更換地板、安裝收納系統）不需要建築許可證。但如果涉及以下工程則需要許可證：移動或新增電路（電力許可證）、新增或移位水管（水管許可證）、拆除或改動承重牆（結構許可證）。

泥屋裝修需要多長時間？

基礎泥屋裝修需1–2週。中等規模泥屋需3–5週。含水管、電力及結構改造的高端泥屋需6–12週。

泥屋裝修值得做嗎？

對於沒有專用入口空間的溫哥華房屋來說，泥屋裝修是回報率最高的裝修項目之一。功能完善的泥屋減少日常打理時間，在出售房屋時也增加吸引力。

常見問題：2026年溫哥華泥屋裝修費用

溫哥華泥屋裝修平均費用是多少？

中等規模泥屋裝修（含半定制收納牆、瓷磚地板、儲物長凳）平均費用約 $8,000–$12,000。基礎輕裝修起步價約 $3,000–$6,000。

泥屋裝修能為房屋增值嗎？

能。設計合理的泥屋增加功能性居住空間，對溫哥華的家庭買家非常有吸引力。在East Vancouver、Burnaby、Coquitlam和列治文等社區回報率尤其明顯。

公寓或聯排別墅可以做泥屋改造嗎？

可以。許多溫哥華公寓和聯排別墅通過改造現有入口衣櫃或閒置角落來實現功能性泥屋。分契式房產可能需要在開工前獲得分契委員會批准。

泥屋最適合用什麼地板？

瓷磚是溫哥華泥屋的最佳選擇——完全防水、耐用、易清潔。豪華乙烯基塑料地板是性價比高的替代方案。密封混凝土適合現代風格房屋。

泥屋裝修需要建築許可證嗎？

裝飾性泥屋裝修不需要許可證。涉及電路改造、水管新增或結構牆改動時需要相應許可證。聚星裝修的項目經理會在開工前確認許可證要求。
